Setelah kehilangan orang tua, Kasym harus melalui masa sulit sebelum masuk ke sebuah sekolah berasrama. Di sana ia menemukan persahabatan dan mengembangkan kemampuannya sebagai penembak. Ketika perang mengubah jalan hidupnya, pengalaman tumbuh tanpa keluarga dan ikatan yang dibangun sejak kecil menjadi bagian penting dari pergulatan yang harus ia hadapi. Forced to start from scratch, Antonio finds a room in an apartment shared with Denis (Eduardo Valdarnini), a free-spirited and charismatic young man. Through Denis, Antonio gets a job at a local bakery owned by Luca (Gianmarco Saurino) and enrolls in a pastry-making course. As he learns the art of baking mascarpone and pastries, Antonio embarks on a journey of personal independence, desire, and self-love, realizing that staying single isn't a loss—it's an opportunity to discover who he truly is.
